name: Apothecary
text: Oh, you've brought the flower! Time to get cookin!

name: Pierre
text: This isn't going to do wierd shit to, is it?

name: Pierre
text: Well, the blue paint makes me dash forward. Kinda dope

text: Oh, does little PissAnt want more powers?

name: Pierre
text: Fuck off old man! Just figured I'd ask

name: Apothecary
text: I don't rightly know if you'll turn into spiderman or anything

text: But these Yellow flowers are known to make one dizzy and light

name: Apothecary
text: Yea, here you go. A beautiful Yellow for ya

name: Pierre
text: Thanks, and if I spin around like a gay fairy...

name: Pierre
text: I'm coming back to make you a real one!

name: Apothecary
text: There is another Red flower in the forest if you can get it.
